Allow recorded-call evidence

Permits authorised assessors to link consented Nylas or native-call recordings and transcripts. Enabling this setting does not record a call or grant media access.

Allow AI assessment drafts

Each requester uses their own connected ChatGPT account and applicable data-sharing consent. AI suggestions are editable drafts; people make the final decision.
